name: payment_allocation_detail
query:
SELECT
  pa.name AS `allocation`,
  pa.payment_entry AS `payment_entry`,
  pe.posting_date AS `posting_date`,
  bd.customer AS `customer`,
  pa.batch AS `batch`,
  pa.due_date AS `due_date`,
  pa.allocated_amount AS `debt_invoiced`,
  pa.previous_paid AS `paid_before`,
  pa.paid_amount AS `this_payment`,
  pa.outstanding_after AS `outstanding_after`
FROM `tabPayment Allocation` pa
JOIN `tabPayment Entry` pe ON pe.name = pa.payment_entry
JOIN `tabBatch Debt` bd ON bd.name = pa.batch_debt
WHERE pa.docstatus = 1
ORDER BY pe.posting_date DESC, pa.creation ASC
